proposals.working_title: Een scooter slepen of duwen in Vietnam: wat de wet toestaat
proposals.intent_rationale: When a rental scooter runs out of fuel or breaks down, a common local reflex is to push it with a foot from another moving bike or tow it with a rope, and travellers do not know that the law bans this for riders and passengers.
proposals.content_angle: Explains the bans in Article 33(3)(đ) and 33(4)(c) of Law 36/2024/QH15 on riders using the bike to tow or push other vehicles and on passengers holding on to, towing or pushing them, the penalties in Article 7(3)(e) and (g) and 7(10)(b) of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, the rules for a stopped broken-down vehicle in Article 18, and safe alternatives such as calling the rental shop or a repair service and the police number 113.
